model.title: Strengthening the Rule of Law in the Brazilian Amazon Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Timothy Kaine (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would authorize U.S. support for law enforcement efforts targeting criminal activity in the Brazilian Amazon, while also promoting American investment opportunities in the region. It aims to strengthen cooperation between the United States and Brazil in combating organized crime and illegal activities that threaten the Amazon's stability and environment.
